opening.argument: The solicitation must be assessed in its full context. The speaker expressly ties the money to building a large organization, saying, "Building an organization of thousands of people, tens of thousands of people, of thousands of people that's where the money is." He describes a founder position costing $3,599 as making "like $100,000 in your pocket," tells participants that with focus "you will be rich," and presents BitClub mining and future trading products alongside those wealth claims. His own description that he was focused on "building a downline, building a distribution channel" shows that recruitment is central to the opportunity. The discussion of Bitcoin prices, operating costs, and security issues does not change the webinar's function as a solicitation built around downlines, paid participation, and extraordinary earnings claims.
